lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Where the grey mist meets the sea,
Ancient whispers ride the evening breeze,
Shadows dance beneath the rowan tree,
Time is woven in the valley's ease.
[Chorus]
Carry my heart to the silver shore,
Where the tide hums a hollow song,
Hold the light that the stars outpour,
Where the roots of the old world belong.
[Verse]
Footprints fade in the velvet moss,
The moon weaves a crown of white,
Every memory is a treasure lost,
Dancing in the fading forest light.
[Chorus]
Carry my heart to the silver shore,
Where the tide hums a hollow song,
Hold the light that the stars outpour,
Where the roots of the old world belong.
[Bridge]
One breath caught in a winter's sigh,
A thousand years in a single blink.
[Chorus]
Carry my heart to the silver shore,
Where the tide hums a hollow song,
Hold the light that the stars outpour,
Where the roots of the old world belong.
[Outro]
